preconditions.name: local_view_greedy_clears_forage_floor_at_d3
preconditions.description: Foraging env is solvable from the 5x5 local view (competence anchor).

preconditions.name: greedy_oracle_clears_forage_floor_at_d3
preconditions.description: Env is floor-achievable with global info (achievability anchor).

preconditions.name: instrument_diversity_spread_registerable
preconditions.description: The instrument registers a between-policy H_greedy SPREAD (the SAME statistic the verdict routes on) on controls with KNOWN-different single-step diversity: random_walk (maximally action-diverse, H_greedy ~= log2(action_dim)) vs a constant-action calibration control (monostrategy, H_greedy == 0). Cannot false-fail on legitimately-similar arms.

preconditions.name: dense_pair_matched_competent
preconditions.description: The decisive representation contrast requires the dense pair (748 vs 749) to be matched-competent -- both clear the forage floor -- so any diversity difference there is NOT explained by competence.

criteria.name: C_representation_gates_diversity_at_matched_competence
criteria.description: |H_greedy(z_world_dense) - H_greedy(raw_dense)| > 0.2 bits on a strict majority of seeds, with the dense pair matched-competent.
